free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Standard class in a 3-AZ (Multi Zone) region is billed from the first GiB at USD 0.00002152 per GiB-hour (about USD 0.0157096 per GiB-month) for the first 50 TiB, with no capacity cap stated
free_tier.notes: billed per GiB-hour; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

per_object_cap.stated: 48 TiB per object through multipart upload (up to 10,000 parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB); 5 GiB through a single PUT
per_object_cap.notes: the Object Storage technical limits page states one set of limits for the Object Storage offer

retention.stated: unlimited time: objects are kept until deleted, and the Standard class has no minimum storage duration
retention.notes: the price table marks the Standard minimum storage billed N/A

egress.terms: External ingoing and outgoing traffic, internal traffic, data retrieval and API requests are all free on the 3-AZ Standard rows

tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, all S3 SDKs

limits.value: 48 TiB per object by multipart upload; 5 GiB by a single PUT

limits_note: Staircase pricing on the 3-AZ Standard class per GiB-month: USD 0.0157096 for the first 50 TiB, USD 0.0140233 for the next 450 TiB, USD 0.012337 over 500 TiB
